units.source_text: 不禁眼泪夺眶而出，便装作若无其事地偷偷揩拭，

en.t: Tears suddenly welled up in his eyes, and he quietly wiped them away while pretending that nothing was the matter,

units.source_text: 不再多言，只是告道：“且待迁京之后，再行奉访，效劳一切。”

en.t: he said no more, but merely told her, "After you have moved to the capital, I will call on you again and help with everything."
Having said this, he rose and took his leave.
